entities.summary: Ottoman, a notable figure in the history of Albania, associated with Albanian Principalities and Skanderbeg (1468–1479). Preceded by Fall of Albania to the Ottomans and Death of Skanderbeg; Albanian resistance continues briefly. Their legacy influenced Islamization of Albania.
